title: pack calls a question none when it spells a hyphenated name the kb holds with a space (Hyper V, Invoke WebRequest, Break Glass)
goal: pack's off-domain name check no longer makes a question none when the name it asks is a part of a hyphenated compound the kb holds and another part of that compound is in the question, as BG-lnmpa27d's changed gate g1 decides: 'How do I enable Hyper V on a Windows 11 device?', 'What does Invoke WebRequest do in PowerShell?', 'What is a Break Glass account?' and 'How does Pay As You Go billing work for Azure?' print no coverage: none, while 'How do I set up VMware Horizon for agents?' still prints coverage: none; a planted case in the existing test_pack_notes_a_subject_held_in_passing... test proves both (no new test id)

run: import subprocess,sys;q=["How do I enable Hyper V on a Windows 11 device?","What does Invoke WebRequest do in PowerShell?","What is a Break Glass account?","How does Pay As You Go billing work for Azure?"];h="How do I set up VMware Horizon for agents?";v={x:subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/rag.py","pack",x,"--budget","150","--format","concise"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split(chr(10))[0] for x in q+[h]};bad=[x for x in q if v[x].startswith("coverage: none")]+([] if v[h].startswith("coverage: none") else [h]);print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

clauses.clause: pack's off-domain name check no longer makes a question none when the name it asks is a part of a hyphenated compound the kb holds and another part of that compound is in the question, as BG-lnmpa27d's changed gate g1 decides: 'How do I enable Hyper V on a Windows 11 device?', 'What does Invoke WebRequest do in PowerShell?', 'What is a Break Glass account?' and 'How does Pay As You Go billing work for Azure?' print no coverage: none, while 'How do I set up VMware Horizon for agents?' still prints coverage: none
a planted case in the existing test_pack_notes_a_subject_held_in_passing... test proves both (no new test id)

notes: Found by the SP-z3jcdsgr review 2026-10-15 in BG-lnmpa27d's work (a53a15cf4, kbfacts.holds_name near line 2628): a hyphen part alone no longer holds a name, so a question that spells a hyphenated name with a space or capital became none with route: web; the reviewer saw Invoke WebRequest, Hyper V, Break Glass, Pay As You Go, Round Robin, Cherry Pick, Tree Sitter and Id JAG go from good to none on main. A one-letter part (the V of Hyper V) may not be a key word of the question: if the rule needs another form (e.g. the question's adjacent words joined with a hyphen match the compound), record it as a provisional gate. Keep long-horizon refused for VMware Horizon. Test budget: extend the existing planted test, no new test id.
